---
title: "Series Fixture"
subtitle: "series yml -> series_assets.py -> series.json -> shortcodes and the four shared slides"
author: "Yunsung Lee"
institute: "WoRV / MaumAI"
title-slide-attributes:
  data-background-gradient: "linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #E8EDF5 100%)"
# The course this deck belongs to. Real decks get it from new_deck.py --series;
# the shortcodes read Figures/lectures/_series/<course>/series.json. This
# fixture's file name is not a session deck, so wherever a shortcode needs
# "the current session" it says week=2 (W02) explicitly; a real deck named
# dgist-2026f-w02 resolves that from the lock by itself.
series: dgist-2026f
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: [default, ../../clean-academic.scss]
    # _fixtures/ is underscore-prefixed, so Quarto treats it as OUTSIDE the
    # project: Quarto/_quarto.yml defaults, the filter, the shortcodes and the
    # font link do NOT apply here and are repeated below. Real decks under
    # Quarto/<genre>/ inherit them from _quarto.yml and set none of this.
    width: 1280
    height: 720
    margin: 0
    center: false
    auto-stretch: false
    slide-number: true
    html-math-method:
      method: katex
      url: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.11/dist/"
    filters:
      - ../../_filters/slide-types.lua
    shortcodes:
      - ../../_filters/video-card.lua
      - ../../_filters/series.lua
    include-in-header:
      - text: '<link rel="stylesheet" href="../../fonts/pretendard.css">'
---
